transport_equipment_activity.label: Transport-equipment activity
transport_equipment_activity.value: Automotive aftermarket replacement parts for passenger vehicles and light trucks, plus heavy-duty trucks

oem_supplier_role.label: OEM / supplier role
oem_supplier_role.value: Aftermarket supplier and designer of replacement parts, sold to retailers and distributors rather than to vehicle OEMs

platform_program_concentration.label: Platform / program concentration
platform_program_concentration.value: Diversified across many vehicle makes, models and model years; no single platform dependence

aftermarket_original_equipment_mix.label: Aftermarket / original-equipment mix
aftermarket_original_equipment_mix.value: Almost entirely aftermarket replacement parts, including hard-to-find dealer-exclusive items; little original-equipment production

notes: No website evidence was provided; the values come from general knowledge of Dorman Products.
